name: tieline
description: Living Story/AC contract and semantic graph grounded in code, tests, help content, and organizational evidence.

scripts.test: npm run test:source-scope && npm run test:contract && npm run test:ranking && npm run test:retrieval && npm run test:embeddings && npm run test:http && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:evidence && npm run test:contract-read && npm run test:baseline && npm run test:topology && npm run test:generated-artifacts && npm run test:integration-entrypoint
scripts.test:tieline: npm run build && npm run test:skill-install && node --import tsx tests/unit/runtime/test-tieline.ts
scripts.benchmark:code-topology: npm run build && node --expose-gc --import tsx benchmarks/benchmark-code-topology.ts
scripts.test:topology: npm run test:parser-package && npm run test:source-snapshot && npm run test:code-analysis:javascript && npm run test:code-analysis:python-rust && npm run test:code-analysis:sql && npm run test:code-resolution:javascript && npm run test:code-resolution:python-rust && npm run test:code-topology-store && npm run test:topology-generation && npm run test:code-topology-artifact && npm run test:code-topology-artifact-command && npm run test:code-topology && npm run test:code-blast-radius && npm run test:code-topology-command
scripts.test:release:focused: npm run test:contract && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:baseline && npm run test:topology && npm run test:generated-artifacts && npm run test:tieline
scripts.test:release:database: npm run test:integration && npm run test:integration:code-topology
scripts.test:release:benchmarks: npm run benchmark:parser-package && npm run benchmark:code-topology && npm run benchmark:code-topology-artifact
scripts.test:contract: tsx tests/unit/contract/test-contract.ts && tsx tests/unit/contract/test-manifest.ts && tsx tests/unit/contract/test-contract-command.ts && tsx tests/unit/contract/test-contract-context-command.ts && tsx tests/unit/contract/test-impact.ts && tsx tests/unit/contract/test-artifact-assurance.ts && tsx tests/unit/contract/test-intent-context.ts && tsx tests/unit/contract/test-link-plausibility.ts && tsx tests/unit/contract/test-reconciliation.ts && tsx tests/unit/contract/test-path-criteria.ts && tsx tests/unit/contract/test-grade.ts
scripts.test:guardrails: npm run test:guardrail:fixtures && npm run test:guardrail:unit && npm run test:guardrail:hooks && npm run test:guardrail:rules
scripts.check:fast: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:guardrails
scripts.check: npm run check:fast && npm run test:tieline && npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts
